clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, Farmer Furlbrow has lost a keepsake from his wedding day. His pocket watch came from Verna’s father, and it was left behind when Defias bandits seized the family’s pumpkin farm.

Farmer Furlbrow and Verna fled their home in the night when Defias bandits swarmed the Furlbrow Pumpkin Patch. In the rush, he left a pocket watch from Verna’s father behind. The watch remains in a wardrobe in the overrun farmhouse, where Benny Blaanco and his cutthroats keep watch. The displaced couple now camps along the road, and the watch is one of the few pieces of their former life the outlaws have not ruined.
